thread:
karen: Quick sync 12: PR #623 drops examples for retention and audit export formats. Legal asked for two small changes: 1) prefer ISO-8601 duration examples alongside seconds, 2) add one-line SOC2-safe sentence about legal hold.

viktor: Link to PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/623. I pushed initial draft with seconds-based TTL.

sophie: Suggestion: show both machine and human formats. e.g. in snippets use ttl_seconds=7776000 and comment "(90 days / P90D)" or use ISO like "PT2160H". Engineers can copy either.

karen: legal-amy asked specifically for ISO-8601 (PnYnMnDTnHnMnS) because some customers prefer declarative durations. Also asked we remove casual language like "forever" and use: "indefinite retention (subject to legal hold)" when describing legal-hold cases.

legal-amy: yes please. Exact sentence for SOC2 pages: "Retention settings shown are tenant-scoped unless explicitly labeled 'global/admin'. Indefinite retention (subject to legal hold) may extend preservation beyond configured TTLs." Keep it as-is.

viktor: OK will add ISO examples. Proposed JS snippet: 

```js
// tenant-scoped: set 90-day retention for tenant 'acme'
client.audit.setRetention({ tenantId: 'acme', ttlSeconds: 90 * 24 * 3600 }); // 7776000 seconds (90 days / P90D)
// Alternative: use ISO-8601 duration for readability: 'P90D'
```

```python
# tenant-scoped: set 90-day retention for tenant 'acme'
client.set_audit_retention(tenant_id='acme', ttl_seconds=7776000)  # 90 days (P90D)
# or use ISO string if consuming system accepts it: ttl='P90D'
```

sophie: also include a tiny JSON export example showing redaction fields and the output schema so customers see what gets removed vs pseudonymized. e.g. 

```json
{"timestamp":"2026-06-01T12:00:00Z","event":"api_call","user":"[REDACTED]","ip":"[PSEUDONYMIZED]","details":{...}}
```

karen: good call. Add a parenthetical note: "Redaction replaces sensitive values with placeholders; pseudonymization may replace with reversible tokens if configured."

viktor: I'll add a short migration note too: "If you migrate from v1 snippets that used raw seconds only, update to include ISO durations for clarity; both formats are accepted by the SDK v2."

legal-amy: one tiny wording tweak: where we mention private/VPC behavior add: "Private deployments may follow customer-managed retention and key policies." That exact phrasing plz.

sophie: action items: viktor to push code + examples, karen to add the SOC2 sentence to compliance landing, legal-amy to sign off after CI, i will run linkcheck and sample rendering.

docs-bot: PR #623 updated by viktor \u2014 https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/klm321 :white_check_mark:

viktor: pushed. PR now includes: dual-format TTL examples (seconds + ISO), JSON export sample with redaction placeholders, SOC2 one-liner, and a short migration note for v1->v2 snippet updates.

karen: thanks all 10. Will merge after legal sign-off.

legal-amy: LGTM pending CI. If reviewers suggest shortening examples, prefer keeping ISO sample and removing redundant seconds-only example.

sophie: noted. I'll trim if needed.

karen: closing loop. Merge after CI + final sign-off.
